title: AquaMaps habitat suitability (native 0.5° and global 0.05°)
description: AquaMaps relative environmental suitability (1-100 percent) for 18,697 aquatic species in two representations, both from MarineSensitivity release v8: the original global 0.5 degree grid (native) and the global 0.05 degree downscale (not the USA-clipped surface of release v7). The COGs are referenced, not copied; one registry row per species lets an app build a per-taxon Item with both COGs without 18,697 Item files. Non-commercial use only (CC BY-NC 3.0). Methods and registry columns: README.md.
sci:citation: Kaschner, K., Kesner-Reyes, K., Garilao, C., Segschneider, J., Rius-Barile, J., Rees, T., Froese, R. (2019). AquaMaps: Predicted range maps for aquatic species. World wide web electronic publication, www.aquamaps.org, Version 10/2019.

providers.name: AquaMaps
providers.description: Kaschner et al. 2019; relative environmental suitability models (www.aquamaps.org)

providers.name: MarineSensitivity
providers.description: published the native 0.5 degree COGs and downscaled the surfaces to a global 0.05 degree grid in release v8

atlas:note: Non-commercial use only (CC BY-NC 3.0). Maps and numbers come from AquaMaps; link back to aquamaps.org when you reuse them.
sdm:method_detail: AquaMaps relative environmental suitability: per species, an envelope of the cell values of six predictors, fitted to occurrence records and expert-checked; published to 0.01 and stored here as Byte 1-100 (0 = no data) on the 0.5 degree HCAF grid (native) and downscaled by MarineSensitivity to a global 0.05 degree grid (release v8).

atlas:item_template.description: Build one Item per registry row, client-side; no Item files are published. Substitute each placeholder in braces with the row's value of the column of that name; omit keys whose value is null. Both assets are listed; `atlas:representation` says which one plays the `data` role (native by default). The Item bbox and geometry are the `atlas:bbox` of that asset.
atlas:item_template.geometry: Polygon of the bbox (west, south, east, north)

registry.title: Taxa registry: one row per AquaMaps model with both a native 0.5 degree and a global 0.05 degree COG (names, ids, COG urls and their EPSG:3857 copies, bboxes)
